personas.standsFor: A sighted customer using a mouse, with no assistive technology.
A customer using a screen reader, or anyone who cannot use a mouse and navigates by Tab and Enter.

method.control: The baseline persona is the control. It perceives the rendered page and uses a pointer. When baseline completes the journey and a constrained persona does not, the site is the variable rather than the model. Runs that failed for infrastructure reasons are excluded from every denominator.
